executive_summary: US markets are experiencing a robust relief rally and massive technical bounce, driven primarily by Jensen Huang's shock reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia, which instantly allayed widespread AI spending fears. Semiconductor infrastructure, memory makers, and high-beta AI proxies are leading broad-based gains, overshadowing lingering geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.

recommendations.catalyst: Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO following high-level board and administration alignment, ending uncertainty.
recommendations.strategy: Scale in on minor intraday pullbacks; maintain strict risk management given rapid momentum spikes.
recommendations.risk: Governance scrutiny, elevated valuation multiples, and broader regulatory overhang.

recommendations.strategy: Buy momentum breakouts with initial stop-loss below the $650 support level.
recommendations.risk: Cyclical memory pricing downturns and supply chain constraints.
